title: Fixed-budget offline fit of the stage-3 best-response target at the three A400 checkpoints
question: Can the existing A400 features (head-only fit), or the same architecture with trainable hidden layers (full fit), express the stage-3 best response to a frozen mean opponent under a fixed optimization budget?
status: offline diagnostic only: the BR labels never enter PPO training, and a fitted policy is not an equilibrium candidate because its opponent is frozen

sources.manifest: E/manifests/asamp_abc_q60_baseline.json (game, PPO, RNG namespaces, verifier tiers read from resolved)

fixed_opponent: mean effort of the A400 actor at the opponent's own signed state: e_O(d) = mean_fn(3, -d) from E/W make_policy_fns (float32 network, float64 mean). Step 1 established that the A400 opponent equals the A400 actor. e_O is computed once per seed and never changes.

target.Q: Q(d, e) = -k e^2 + w_l + dW * F_xi(d + e - e_O(d)) (stage 3, closed-form terminal expectation, float64)
target.best_response: a_BR(d) = argmax_{e in [e_min, e_max]} Q(d, e). For these parameters Q is strictly concave in e (Q'' <= -2k + dW/(4 q^2) < 0 on every piece and Q' is continuous), so a_BR is the unique root of Q'(e) = -2 k e + dW f_xi(d + e - e_O(d)) on [0, 100], or 0 when Q'(0) <= 0; solved by vectorized bisection to 1e-10
target.cross_check: on the evaluation grid (= the final verifier's stage-3 grid) a_BR, V_BR and the original actor's loss are compared with the final-tier verifier arrays of the A400 actor (reported, max abs differences)

grids.eval: d = -440, -438, ..., 440 (441 points, step 2) = the final verifier's stage-3 grid; interleaved with the training grid, so no evaluation state is a training state
grids.weighting: uniform over the grid (matches the uniform D3 exploring-start distribution)

policy_effort: e_theta(d) = e_range * clamp(sigmoid(z_mu(d)), 1e-6, 1-1e-6) = the Beta mean of the actor (alpha/(alpha+beta) = mu). Training uses this float32 functional form; final evaluation uses the actor forward through make_policy_fns (float64 mean from float32 alpha, beta) and both are compared.

arms.original: A400 actor, no fitting (current policy error)
arms.head_only: start at A400; hidden layers l1, l2 frozen; fit only the mean head out.weight[0,:] and out.bias[0] (65 parameters); concentration head out.weight[1,:], out.bias[1] frozen
arms.full: start at A400; fit l1, l2 and the mean head (4418 parameters); concentration head frozen
arms.full_from_init: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, not part of the interpretation: same as full but starting from the seed's exact PPO initialization theta_0 (make_streams(seed, q, namespaces) -> CurriculumPPO, as in E's runner; verified by reproducing weights/update_00025.npz bit-for-bit with 25 original phase-A training updates). It compares supervised fitting with PPO from the same start, same optimizer and same step count.

objective: effort MSE: mean over the training grid of (e_theta(d) - a_BR(d))^2 in effort units^2; float32; full batch; deterministic (no RNG)
optimizer: torch.optim.Adam(lr=3e-4, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0) = the PPO actor optimizer settings; fresh optimizer state; no gradient clipping

budget.primary_rationale: number of actor optimizer steps PPO made in phase A: 400 updates x 10 epochs x (512 / 256) minibatches
budget.extension_rule: the same run continued to 80000 steps; its values are reported to show whether the primary budget was binding and never enter the interpretation

metrics_on_eval_grid.regions: all D3; center |d| <= B (B = 220); outer |d| > B
metrics_on_eval_grid.effort_error: RMSE and max |e_theta(d) - a_BR(d)| per region
metrics_on_eval_grid.payoff_loss: L(d) = V_BR(d) - Q(d, e_theta(d)) >= 0 against the frozen opponent; max and mean of L/dW per region and the argmax state
metrics_on_eval_grid.policy_curves: e_theta(d) before fitting, at 8000 and at 80000 steps; a_BR(d); e_O(d)
metrics_on_eval_grid.parameter_change: ||theta - theta_start||_2 over the fitted parameters and per group (l1, l2, mean head), relative norms, max |delta|, max |theta|; reference scale: PPO's phase-A displacement ||theta_A400 - theta_0|| of the same groups
metrics_on_eval_grid.fitting_curves: train MSE, eval effort RMSE, eval max and mean payoff loss, parameter-change norm vs step
metrics_on_eval_grid.side_effect: maximum normalized Beta std on the evaluation grid before and after fitting (the concentration head is frozen, but in the full arms its input features change)

success_definition: an arm succeeds for a seed iff at the primary budget (step 8000) max_{d in eval grid} L(d)/dW <= 0.01 over all of D3 (the protocol's per-criterion threshold scale)

descriptive_flags.large_change: an arm is flagged when its ||theta - theta_start|| over the fitted parameters exceeds PPO's phase-A displacement ||theta_A400 - theta_0|| over the same parameters
descriptive_flags.first_success_step: first logged step at which the success condition holds

interpretation_per_seed.head_only succeeds: existing features are sufficient; prioritize studying PPO's signal, update and optimization process
interpretation_per_seed.only full succeeds: the same architecture can express the target, but the current training did not learn suitable features
interpretation_per_seed.both fail: only that this finite fit did not succeed; it does not establish insufficient network capacity and is not a reason to enlarge the network immediately
interpretation_per_seed.across seeds: reported per seed; a common reading is stated only if all 3 seeds agree

out_of_scope: no full ABC, q50 or formal runs; no change to PPO, verifier, certification thresholds or concentration; BR labels are never used for training; the Step-1 decision.json stays unchanged; the Step-1 statistical anomaly stays unresolved (no additional sampling, not declared a code bug)
